ai.summary: Anthropic shares fell on Friday after their record-setting public debut, reflecting broader weakness in AI and technology stocks. Reuters reported the company raised $93.5 billion after underwriters exercised their option to buy additional shares.
ai.title: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade

ai.summary: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year, beating its prior forecast. The result underscores the scale of demand for AI computing infrastructure.
ai.title: Nvidia quarterly results and AI chip demand

ai.summary: At its Ignite conference, Microsoft introduced a suite of AI models, including a coding model and a cybersecurity-focused model. The launch expands Microsoft's effort to compete with established AI model providers.
ai.title: Microsoft unveils AI models for coding, cybersecurity as it takes on Anthropic, OpenAI

ai.source: What Claude Users Should Expect after the IPO
ai.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra for demanding professional tasks and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday use, with both available through its products and API. The report says Astra's API prices are 20% below those of its predecessor.
ai.title: What Claude Users Should Expect after the IPO

ai.summary: A U.S. Senate permitting bill passed 62–33; the report says it would speed energy-project reviews and require data centers to pay for grid upgrades. The measure addresses infrastructure pressures associated with rising electricity demand, including from AI data centers.
ai.title: Morning edition — Friday 20 November 2026

quantum.summary: Google researchers reported contextuality experiments on Willow processors, including a 98.3% win rate in a four-qubit magic-square game—above the 88.9% classical limit—and tests on systems up to 105 qubits. The work offers a possible hardware diagnostic; it does not establish a general quantum-computing advantage.
quantum.title: Google demonstrates quantum contextuality on Willow processors

quantum.summary: A Harvard-led collaboration received $12 million from the U.S. Department of Energy for ASQC, a project using AI to tailor quantum error-correction codes and decoders to scientific workloads. The team plans to test the methods on hardware at Harvard, MIT, and QuEra.
quantum.title: Harvard-led team receives $12 million to advance quantum computing with AI

quantum.summary: A French National Quantum Strategy-backed consortium led by VIQTHOR received €14 million to develop integrated qubit-control and readout systems using photonic and superconducting interconnects. Its stated targets include demonstrators for 1,000 qubits by 2028 and 10,000 by 2030.
quantum.title: French strategy backs €14 million Qubit Control 2030 consortium

quantum.source: HUN-REN Wigner Research Centre for Physics
quantum.summary: The AI4QT Hungarian-German project announced results including Simphony, a noise-aware simulator, and QUASAR, a compiler for star-topology architectures. The consortium also reported benchmarking 12 processors from six manufacturers using new metrics, with Quantinuum’s H2-1 achieving the highest Clifford volume in its tests.
quantum.title: AI4QT project announces tools and benchmarks for quantum processors
